[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The subject for this blank is "**overreliance on synthetic environments**." • The headword of the subject is "**overreliance**," which is an **uncountable/singular noun**. • According to the rules of **Subject-Verb Agreement**, a singular subject requires a singular verb. In the simple present tense, the singular form of the verb "erode" is "**erodes**." • Furthermore, the sentence features a compound predicate: "erodes human agency **and fragments__** collective identity" (implied parallel structure). Even though the blank comes before the first verb, it must match the singular nature of the second verb's logic. • "**Erode**" (Option 1) is the plural form, which would be incorrect for the singular headword "overreliance." • "**Eroded**" (Option 3) is the past tense. The passage uses the **present tense** ("herald," "caution," "demands") to discuss ongoing philosophical and technological concerns. • "**Eroding**" (Option 4) is a present participle and cannot function as the main finite verb of the clause without an auxiliary verb. Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'. Complete Passage Segment: *As technological ingenuity accelerates exponentially, humanity stands poised at an inflection point, wherein virtual realms (1) __are beginning to__ rival the tangible world in complexity and significance. Virtual reality (VR), once relegated to the domain of speculative fiction, now engenders immersive ecosystems capable of simulating emotional, sensory, and cognitive experiences with bewildering verisimilitude. Nevertheless, despite its sophistication, VR often lacks the existential gravitas intrinsic to corporeal existence, the ontological authenticity that roots human consciousness in materiality. While proponents of VR herald it as the progenitor of a post-physical civilization, skeptics caution that overreliance on synthetic environments (2) __erodes__ human agency and fragment collective identity. A crucial determinant in this dialectic will be how societies negotiate the (3) liminality between augmentation and escapism. Actual reality, laden with imperfections, demands resilience, compromise, and ethical engagement — qualities often attenuated in consequence-free virtual spaces. Conversely, VR offers avenues for radical creativity, democratization of experiences, and transcendence of biological constraints. Thus, whichever modality predominates in shaping the next civilization, the imperative to cultivate critical consciousness (4) ____ paramount. Moreover, if virtual domains evolve without regulatory frameworks imbued with philosophical rigor, humanity may inadvertently engender a hyper-fragmented reality devoid of epistemic cohesion. Within such a milieu, distinguishing truth from fabrication becomes not merely challenging but (5) Sisyphean. Thus, the onus falls upon contemporary thinkers, technologists, and policymakers to steer civilization toward a future where both virtual and actual realities coalesce, enhancing rather than diminishing the human condition.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Human Agency (मानवीय अभिकर्तृत्व):** The capacity of individuals to act independently and to make their own free choices. The passage suggests that overreliance on VR might weaken this capacity. • **Synthetic Environments:** Computer-generated worlds or simulations (VR). • **Parallelism:** In competitive exams, when a subject performs two actions (erodes... and fragments...), both verbs must agree with that same subject in form and tense. 36:Tbcf,
